create_GoogleBatchEmbeddings: create a GoogleBatchEmbeddings instance to generate embeddings via Vertex AI or Gemini batch endpoints
run_batch_embeddings: run batch embeddings on text input using sync HTTP handler for Gemini or Vertex AI models
run_async_batch_embeddings: run async batch embeddings on text input using async HTTP handler for Gemini or Vertex AI models
resolve_file_references: resolve Gemini file references in embedding input to retrieve mime_type and uri via API calls
run_async_resolve_file_references: resolve Gemini file references in embedding input asynchronously via HTTP GET requests
